verdict.rationale: Unreal ships multiple official, well-documented SDKs/APIs — C++ gameplay/programming API, Python editor-scripting API, Blueprint visual scripting, and a Remote Control REST/WebSocket API for external tool integration — all documented on dev.epicgames.com and corroborated by community usage reports of building with C++/Python/Blueprints. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of building AI-native tooling against these SDKs, and probe evidence shows inconsistent machine-readability (WAF 403s, no official MCP) which could hinder automated/agentic consumption of the docs and APIs.
